newsitem.title: USA: PAR Tech sees Q2 loss, revs shortfall.
newsitem.headline: PAR Tech sees Q2 loss, revs shortfall.

text.p: PAR Technology Corp said Monday it expects to report a net loss and a shortfall in revenues for the second quarter.
The company said it will be taking two one-time charges relating to its accounts receivable from Phoenix Systems & Technologies Inc and its Corneal Topography System business.
It said it expects the loss to range between $0.50 a share and $0.54 a share on revenues of between $21 million and $22 million.
Earnings per share for the same period last year were $0.11, it added.
PAR said it would record an after-tax charge $2.0 million or $0.22 per share relating to its Phoneix charge and $500,000 or $0.07 per share for its Corneal business.
The company said it was talking with Phoenix to recover its money.
